en: Sepia-toned theatrical postcard showing three actors on a stage-like set. On the left, a woman in an ornate dress extends her hand back toward a man in the center in formal evening wear who reaches toward her. On the right, an older man in a suit holds a large candelabrum. Stylized German titles and the actors' names are printed on the image, along with a small publisher's mark and a city and year in the lower right.
